items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I met him too. ... George got up out of his sick bed when he first got a stroke, come down, I played a concert, walked in there, looked at me.

ctx.x: P.G. Laurel. Yeah. See, now, all them guys, now George, George, back there, I was, George, back there was like a picture on the wall of me. I just thought he was the greatest thing in the world, George. And George was a nice man. Oh, yes. I met him too. And I don't care where you was playing, if you knew you was in that band from New Orleans, he, he, he, he'd come there to see you. George got up out of his sick bed when he first got a stroke, come down, I played a concert, walked in there, looked at me. Shake his…
In Philadelphia. Philadelphia, yeah. That's where I saw him. A couple of times, never got to talk to him very much.
